end.parentNote: Asha practised visualising square and triangular numbers with dot pictures, row sums, subtraction, and border counting. Ishita clearly explained why 3 × 3 forms a square and used two methods to correct the shared-corner double count. At home, ask them to draw 4 × 4 and 5 × 5 squares and count only the new border dots when moving between them.
